    tr.date,
    tr.amount,
    CASE WHEN lm.loan_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS cleared_recent_installment
FROM trans tr
INNER JOIN account acc ON tr.account_id = acc.account_id
LEFT JOIN loans_with_most_recent lm ON tr.account_id = lm.account_id
WHERE tr.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND acc.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM qualifying_districts)
ORDER BY tr.amount DESC;

WITH district_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(A15) AS avg_1995_crime FROM district
),
target_districts AS (
    SELECT district_id FROM district, district_avg
    WHERE A16 > district_avg.avg_1995_crime
),
target_accounts AS (
    SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM target_districts)
),
latest_loan_payment AS (
    SELECT MAX(t.date) AS latest_date
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM target_accounts)
      AND t.k_symbol = 'UVER'
),
utilized_trans AS (
    SELECT t.trans_id
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
      AND t.k_symbol = 'UVER'
      AND t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM target_accounts)
      AND t.date = (SELECT latest_date FROM latest_loan_payment)
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t.amount DESC) AS volume_rank,
    CASE WHEN t.trans_id IN (SELECT trans_id FROM utilized_trans) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS utilized
FROM trans t
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
ORDER BY volume_rank;
